'''Silins''' is a NPC male student that can be found in the Rabelle College classroom during the afternoon. 

==Idle==
:'''Silins:''' I don't understand why people don't like it.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Silins:''' I've been listening to that [[Fleet Snowfluff]] album back-to-back for three days straight...
:'''Silins:''' I based this algorithm entirely on her music's modes and lyrical structures.
:'''Silins:''' The logic is sound. The methodology is precise...
:'''Silins:''' So why does everyone hate the music my algorithm writes?
{{Dialogue End}}
